extra.tooMany:
{{pokemonName}} has too many
of this item!

PokemonHpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} HP or {{restorePercent}}% HP for one Pokémon, whichever is higher.

extra.fully: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon.
extra.fullyWithStatus: Fully restores HP for one Pokémon and heals any status ailment.

PokemonReviveModifierType.description: Revives one Pokémon and restores {{restorePercent}}% HP.

PokemonStatusHealModifierType.description: Heals any status ailment for one Pokémon.

PokemonPpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} PP for one Pokémon move.

extra.fully: Restores all PP for one Pokémon move.

PokemonAllMovePpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} PP for all of one Pokémon’s moves.

extra.fully: Restores all PP for all of one Pokémon’s moves.

PokemonPpUpModifierType.description: Permanently increases PP for one Pokémon move by {{upPoints}} for every 5 maximum PP (maximum 3).

PokemonNatureChangeModifierType.name: {{natureName}} Mint
PokemonNatureChangeModifierType.description: Changes a Pokémon’s nature to {{natureName}} and permanently unlocks the nature for the starter.

DoubleBattleChanceBoosterModifierType.description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to {{battleCount}} battles.

TempStatStageBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the {{stat}} of all party members by {{amount}} for up to 5 battles.

AttackTypeBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the power of a Pokémon’s {{moveType}}-type moves by 20%.

AllPokemonLevelIncrementModifierType.description: Increases all party members’ level by {{levels}}.

BaseStatBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s base {{stat}} by {{percent}}%. The higher your IVs, the higher the stack limit.

IvCandyModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s base {{stat}} by {{percent}}%, on top of any vitamins (multiplied). The higher your IVs, the higher the stack limit.

PokemonBaseStatFlatModifierType.name: Old Gateau
PokemonBaseStatFlatModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s {{stats}} base stats by {{statValue}}. Found after a strange dream.

AllPokemonFullReviveModifierType.description: Revives all fainted Pokémon, fully restoring HP.

ExpBoosterModifierType.description: Increases gain of Exp. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

PokemonExpBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s gain of Exp. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

PokemonMultiHitModifierType.description: Each lens adds one more strike at 25% damage; the first strike deals 75% (up to 3).

TmModifierTypeWithInfo.name: TM{{moveId}} - {{moveName}}
TmModifierTypeWithInfo.description:
Teach {{moveName}} to a Pokémon
(Hold C or Shift for more info).

FormChangeItemModifierType.description: Causes certain Pokémon to change form.

FusePokemonModifierType.description: Combines two Pokémon (transfers Ability, splits base stats and types, shares move pool).

TerastallizeModifierType.name: {{teraType}} Tera Shard
TerastallizeModifierType.description: Changes the Pokémon’s Tera type to {{teraType}}.

ContactHeldItemTransferChanceModifierTyp.description: Upon attacking, there is a {{chancePercent}}% chance the foe’s held item will be stolen.

TurnHeldItemTransferModifierType.description: Every turn, the holder acquires one held item from the foe.

EnemyAttackStatusEffectChanceModifierTyp.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to inflict {{statusEffect}} with attack moves.

EnemyEndureChanceModifierType.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance of enduring a hit.

CANDY_PILE.name: Candy Pile
CANDY_PILE.description: Uses 5 Rare Candies and 2 Rarer Candies at once, with Candy Jars counted twice for the chosen Pokémon and once for the rest: the chosen Pokémon gains {{targetLevels}} levels and the rest of the party {{partyLevels}}.

TERA_ORB.name: Tera Orb
TERA_ORB.description: Allows your Pokémon to Terastallize. Recharges slowly. Tera Shards also become available.

MAP.name: Map
MAP.description: Allows you to choose your destination at a crossroads.

REVIVER_SEED.name: Reviver Seed
REVIVER_SEED.description: Revives the holder for 1/2 HP upon fainting from a direct hit.

WHITE_HERB.name: White Herb
WHITE_HERB.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle.

MASTER_TM.name: Master TM
MASTER_TM.description: A special black TM. Teaches a Pokémon any one move you choose, even another Pokémon’s signature move or a one-hit KO move. It is used up once the move is taught.
MASTER_TM.chooseType: Choose the type of the move to teach.

EXP_SHARE.name: Exp. All
EXP_SHARE.description: Non-participants receive 20% of a single participant’s Exp. Points.

EXP_BALANCE.name: Exp. Balance
EXP_BALANCE.description: Weighs Exp. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.

OVAL_CHARM.name: Oval Charm
OVAL_CHARM.description: When multiple Pokémon participate in a battle, each gets an extra 10% of the total Exp.

SCOPE_LENS.name: Scope Lens
SCOPE_LENS.description: It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. Each lens raises the holder’s critical-hit stage by 1 (up to 3; 3 always crit).

LEEK.name: Leek
LEEK.description: This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of Farfetch’d’s moves.

EVIOLITE.name: Eviolite
EVIOLITE.description: This mysterious evolutionary lump boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats when held by a Pokémon that can still evolve.

RED_EVOLUTION_CRYSTAL.name: Red Eviolite
RED_EVOLUTION_CRYSTAL.description: This mysterious red evolutionary lump raises the Attack stat by 50% when held by a Pokémon that can still evolve.

BLUE_EVOLUTION_CRYSTAL.name: Blue Eviolite
BLUE_EVOLUTION_CRYSTAL.description: This mysterious blue evolutionary lump raises the Sp. Atk stat by 50% when held by a Pokémon that can still evolve.

ASSAULT_VEST.name: Assault Vest
ASSAULT_VEST.description: Raises the holder’s Sp. Def by 50% per vest (x1.5/x2/x2.5, up to 3). The holder can’t use stat-raising status moves.

BULLETPROOF_VEST.name: Bulletproof Vest
BULLETPROOF_VEST.description: A grey reinforced vest. Raises the holder’s Defense by 50% per vest (x1.5/x2/x2.5, up to 3). The holder can’t use stat-raising status moves.

CHOICE_BAND.name: Choice Band
CHOICE_BAND.description: Raises the holder’s Attack by 50%, but it can only use the first move it used. Switching out or the end of the battle lifts the lock.

CHOICE_SCARF.name: Choice Scarf
CHOICE_SCARF.description: Raises the holder’s Speed by 50%, but it can only use the first move it used. Switching out or the end of the battle lifts the lock.

CHOICE_SPECS.name: Choice Specs
CHOICE_SPECS.description: Raises the holder’s Sp. Atk by 50%, but it can only use the first move it used. Switching out or the end of the battle lifts the lock.

CHOICE_ARMOR.name: Choice Armor
CHOICE_ARMOR.description: Raises the holder’s Defense and Sp. Def by 30%, but it can only use the first move it used. Switching out or the end of the battle lifts the lock.

PRISM.name: Prism
PRISM.description: Single-target attacks also deal 50/75/100% of their damage (1/2/3 Prisms, up to 3) to the target’s partner (double battles). Spread moves are not affected.

LIFE_ORB.name: Life Orb
LIFE_ORB.description: Attacks deal 30% more damage per orb (x1.3/x1.6/x1.9). After a turn in which the holder attacked, it loses 10/15/20% of its max HP.

TRAINING_SHACKLES.name: Training Shackles
TRAINING_SHACKLES.description: Halves the holder’s Speed but raises its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 20%. With two, Speed falls to 1/3 and those stats rise by 40%.

ULTIMATE_GENE.name: Ultimate Gene
ULTIMATE_GENE.description: Raises the holder’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed by 20%. Held by Mewtwo, by 40%.

FLAME_CAULDRON.name: Flame Cauldron
FLAME_CAULDRON.description: A cauldron holding the ashes of something burnt. It looks like it needs something to light it again.

RADIOACTIVE_WASTE.name: Radioactive Waste
RADIOACTIVE_WASTE.description: Held by a Poison-type Pokémon, it restores 1/8 of the holder’s max HP every turn. Any other holder is poisoned.

FLAME_FURNACE.name: Flame Furnace
FLAME_FURNACE.description: A furnace blazing once more. Its fiery heat raises the holder's Attack and Sp. Atk by 30%.

TOXIC_DISTILLER.name: Toxic Distiller
TOXIC_DISTILLER.description: A distiller with nothing inside. It looks like it needs something potent to distill.

TOXIC_DISTILLATE.name: Toxic Distillate
TOXIC_DISTILLATE.description: A flask of thickly distilled toxin. Its potent fumes raise the holder's Defense and Sp. Def by 30%.

DISCHARGED_COIL.name: Discharged Coil
DISCHARGED_COIL.description: A coil with all of its charge drained away. It looks like it needs something to recharge it.

SUPERCONDUCTING_COIL.name: Superconducting Coil
SUPERCONDUCTING_COIL.description: A coil brimming with electricity in a superconducting state. Its unimpeded current raises the holder's Speed, and the effect is doubled for the Pikachu line.

PUNCHING_GLOVE.name: Punching Glove
PUNCHING_GLOVE.description: Boosts the power of the holder's punching moves by 10%. They no longer make contact for the target's Abilities or protection moves such as King's Shield, while the holder's own contact bonuses such as Tough Claws still apply.

MASTER_PUNCHING_GLOVE.name: Master Punching Glove
MASTER_PUNCHING_GLOVE.description: Boosts the power of the holder's contact moves by 20% and keeps them from making contact for the target. They also go through moves such as Protect, dealing 1/4 damage.

POWER_HERB.name: Power Herb
POWER_HERB.description: Lets the holder use a move that takes two turns right away, skipping its charging turn. Works as many times per battle as the number held and is not used up (max 2). No effect on Sky Drop.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.description: Each consecutive use of the same move boosts its power by 10/15/20% with 1/2/3 held (up to 5 times: x1.5/x1.75/x2). Using a different move, failing or missing resets it.

LOADED_DICE.name: Loaded Dice
LOADED_DICE.description: Moves that strike two to five times strike four or five times. Triple Kick, Triple Axel and Population Bomb check accuracy only once, and Population Bomb strikes four to ten times.

SEED_POUCH.name: Seed Pouch
SEED_POUCH.description: When held by a Grass-type Pokémon, plants Leech Seed on every opposing Pokémon when the holder comes into battle, and on opponents that come in while it is out. No effect on other types.

FUEL.name: Fuel
FUEL.description: A drum full of oil. When held by a Fire-type Pokémon, raises its Attack and Sp. Atk by 10% per Fuel (x1.1/x1.2/x1.3, max 3).

EXPERT_BELT.name: Expert Belt
EXPERT_BELT.description: Boosts the damage of the holder's supereffective moves by 20%.

PRECISION_LENS.name: Precision Lens
PRECISION_LENS.description: A lens made only for striking vital spots. With 1/2 held, critical hits deal x1.7/x1.8 damage instead of x1.5 (max 2). The critical-hit ratio is not raised.

CLEAR_AMULET.name: Clear Amulet
CLEAR_AMULET.description: A clear, sparkling amulet. Prevents other Pokémon's moves and Abilities from lowering the holder's stats. Its own moves can still lower them.

BOOSTER_ENERGY.name: Booster Energy
BOOSTER_ENERGY.description: A capsule full of energy. Boosts the holder's highest stat by 20%, or by 50% for a Paradox Pokémon (Koraidon and Miraidon too). Never used up.

THROAT_SPRAY.name: Throat Spray
THROAT_SPRAY.description: A throat spray. Raises the holder's Sp. Atk by 1 stage when it uses a sound-based move, once per battle. Never used up.

MUSCLE_BAND.name: Muscle Band
MUSCLE_BAND.description: A headband that exudes strength. Boosts the power of the holder's physical moves by 10% per band (added up, up to 99).

WISE_GLASSES.name: Wise Glasses
WISE_GLASSES.description: A thick pair of glasses. Boosts the power of the holder's special moves by 10% per pair (added up, up to 99).

WEIGHT_BAND.name: Weight Band
WEIGHT_BAND.description: A heavy training band. Raises the holder's max HP by 10% per band (added up, up to 3).

CHAMPION_BELT.name: Champion Belt
CHAMPION_BELT.description: A belt worn by champions. Raises the holder's max HP by 45% (added to the Weight Bands' boost, one per Pokémon).

POWER_WEIGHT.name: Power Weight
POWER_WEIGHT.description: A heavy weight for training. Each time the holder takes part in a battle and gets a defeated foe's EXP, its HP EVs rise by 1 (up to 504; not from the EXP Share alone). Only one per party.

POWER_BRACER.name: Power Bracer
POWER_BRACER.description: A heavy bracer for training. Each time the holder takes part in a battle and gets a defeated foe's EXP, its Attack EVs rise by 1 (up to 252; not from the EXP Share alone). Only one per party.

POWER_BELT.name: Power Belt
POWER_BELT.description: A heavy belt for training. Each time the holder takes part in a battle and gets a defeated foe's EXP, its Defense EVs rise by 1 (up to 252; not from the EXP Share alone). Only one per party.

POWER_LENS.name: Power Lens
POWER_LENS.description: A heavy lens for training. Each time the holder takes part in a battle and gets a defeated foe's EXP, its Sp. Atk EVs rise by 1 (up to 252; not from the EXP Share alone). Only one per party.

POWER_BAND.name: Power Band
POWER_BAND.description: A heavy band for training. Each time the holder takes part in a battle and gets a defeated foe's EXP, its Sp. Def EVs rise by 1 (up to 252; not from the EXP Share alone). Only one per party.

POWER_ANKLET.name: Power Anklet
POWER_ANKLET.description: A heavy anklet for training. Each time the holder takes part in a battle and gets a defeated foe's EXP, its Speed EVs rise by 1 (up to 252; not from the EXP Share alone). Only one per party.

FORGED_STEEL.name: Forged Steel
FORGED_STEEL.description: Raises base HP, Defense and Sp. Def by 10% per piece (added up, x1.1 to x2.0, up to 10).

SOUL_DEW.name: Soul Dew
SOUL_DEW.description: Increases the influence of a Pokémon’s nature on its stats by 10% (additive).

GOLDEN_PUNCH.name: Golden Punch
GOLDEN_PUNCH.description: Grants 50% of direct damage inflicted as money.

COIN_CASE.name: Coin Case
COIN_CASE.description: After every 10th battle, receive 10% of your money in interest.

LOCK_CAPSULE.name: Lock Capsule
LOCK_CAPSULE.description: Allows you to lock item rarities when rerolling items.

HEALING_CHARM.name: Healing Charm
HEALING_CHARM.description: Increases the effectiveness of HP restoring moves and items by 10% (excludes Revives).

CANDY_JAR.name: Candy Jar
CANDY_JAR.description: Increases the number of levels added by Rare Candy items by 1.

BERRY_POUCH.name: Berry Pouch
BERRY_POUCH.description: Adds a 30% chance that a used berry will not be consumed.

FOCUS_BAND.name: Focus Band
FOCUS_BAND.description: Adds a 10% chance to survive with 1 HP after being damaged enough to faint.

QUICK_CLAW.name: Quick Claw
QUICK_CLAW.description: Adds a 10% chance to move first regardless of speed (after priority).

KINGS_ROCK.name: King’s Rock
KINGS_ROCK.description: Adds a 10% chance an attack move will cause the opponent to flinch.

LEFTOVERS.name: Leftovers
LEFTOVERS.description: Heals 1/16 of a Pokémon’s maximum HP every turn.

SHELL_BELL.name: Shell Bell
SHELL_BELL.description: Heals 1/8 of a Pokémon’s dealt damage.

TOXIC_ORB.name: Toxic Orb
TOXIC_ORB.description: It’s a bizarre orb that exudes toxins when touched and will badly poison the holder during battle.

FLAME_ORB.name: Flame Orb
FLAME_ORB.description: It’s a bizarre orb that gives off heat when touched and will affect the holder with a burn during battle.

MYSTICAL_ROCK.name: Mystical Rock
MYSTICAL_ROCK.description: Extends the duration of terrain and weather caused by the holder’s moves or Abilities by 2 turns.

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_GIMMIGHOUL.name: Treasures
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_GIMMIGHOUL.description: This Pokémon loves treasure! Keep collecting treasure and something might happen!

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_PRIMEAPE.name: Rage Fist
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_PRIMEAPE.description:
Primeape evolves when its rage surpasses the limits of its physical form!
Build up its rage by using the move Rage Fist!

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_STANTLER.name: Psyshield Bash
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_STANTLER.description: Stantler evolves to adapt to harsh environments. Toughen up its defense by using the move Psyshield Bash!

BATON.name: Baton
BATON.description: Allows passing along effects when switching Pokémon, which also bypasses traps.

SHINY_CHARM.name: Shiny Charm
SHINY_CHARM.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon being Shiny.

ABILITY_CHARM.name: Ability Charm
ABILITY_CHARM.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon having a Hidden Ability.

CATCHING_CHARM.name: Catching Charm
CATCHING_CHARM.description: Increases the chance of getting a critical catch.

IV_SCANNER.name: IV Scanner
IV_SCANNER.description: Enables scanning the IVs of wild Pokémon.

FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER_LEAF.name: Four-Leaf Clover Leaf
FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER_LEAF.description: A single leaf from a four-leaf clover. Collect all 4 to raise your luck by 1.

FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.name: Four-Leaf Clover
FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.description: A four-leaf clover said to bring good fortune. Raises your luck by 1.

GOLDEN_FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.name: Golden Four-Leaf Clover
GOLDEN_FOUR_LEAF_CLOVER.description: A four-leaf clover shining with a golden light. Raises your luck by 3.

PIERCING_TOKEN.name: Piercing Token
PIERCING_TOKEN.description: Gives back 0.25 percentage points of the damage the foe's Protection Tokens take away, per token. Never more than the damage without them.

GUARD_TOKEN.name: Guard Token
GUARD_TOKEN.description: Reduces damage taken by party Pokémon from foes' attacks by 0.5% per stack (multiplicative).

GOLDEN_POKEBALL.name: Golden Poké Ball
GOLDEN_POKEBALL.description: Adds 1 extra item option at the end of every battle.

ENEMY_HEAL.name: Recovery Token
ENEMY_HEAL.description: Heals 2% of max HP every turn.

ENEMY_STATUS_EFFECT_HEAL_CHANCE.name: Full Heal Token
ENEMY_STATUS_EFFECT_HEAL_CHANCE.description: Adds a 2.5% chance every turn to heal a status condition.

ENEMY_FUSED_CHANCE.name: Fusion Token
ENEMY_FUSED_CHANCE.description: Adds a 1% chance that a wild Pokémon will be a fusion.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_GOOD.name: Sweet Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_GOOD.description: Increases all of the holder’s base stats. You were blessed by the Shuckle.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_BAD.name: Foul Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_BAD.description: Decreases all of the holder’s base stats. You were cursed by the Shuckle.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_DARK.name: Pitch-Black Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_DARK.description: Greatly increases all of the holder’s base stats. The Shuckle’s pitch-black power has seeped into its whole body.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_BLACK_SLUDGE.name: Black Sludge
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_BLACK_SLUDGE.description: The stench is so powerful that shops will only sell you items at a steep cost increase.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_MACHO_BRACE.name: Macho Brace
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_MACHO_BRACE.description: Defeating a Pokémon grants the holder a stack of it. Each stack boosts stats a bit. Bonus at max stacks.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_OLD_GATEAU.name: Old Gateau
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_OLD_GATEAU.description: Increases some of the holder’s stats.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_GOLDEN_BUG_NET.name: Golden Bug Net
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_GOLDEN_BUG_NET.description: Imbues the owner with luck to find Bug Type Pokémon more often. Has a strange heft to it.

LIGHT_BALL.name: Light Ball
LIGHT_BALL.description: It’s a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

THICK_CLUB.name: Thick Club
THICK_CLUB.description: This hard bone of unknown origin boosts Cubone or Marowak’s Attack stat.

METAL_POWDER.name: Metal Powder
METAL_POWDER.description: Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts Ditto’s Defense stat.

QUICK_POWDER.name: Quick Powder
QUICK_POWDER.description: Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts Ditto’s Speed stat.

DEEP_SEA_SCALE.name: Deep Sea Scale
DEEP_SEA_SCALE.description: This scale shines with a faint pink and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Def stat.

DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.name: Deep Sea Tooth
DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.description: This fang gleams a sharp silver and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Atk stat.
